visual_connections.description: Ingests telemetry events from AWS public cloud sources into Apache Metron.
Ingests syslog/Kafka events from on-premise sources into Apache Metron.
Persistent data in Apache Metron is picked up by EMR.
EMR transforms and stores data into S3.
Athena queries data stored in S3.
Feedback loop from Security Data Lake back to Apache Metron to enrich profiles.
Sends alerts from Metron to the SOAR platform.
Analysts trigger mitigation actions on WAF.
